author: EncryptedShoesHD
body:
Hello guys!

Necromancy is a well known team that used to exist a long time ago, but after getting a lot of requests to reopen it, I've decided to finally recreate it. Before Necromancy died, we had a lot of skilled players that made this team even better. Before you apply for the position, please make sure that you meet these requirements:
  • Minimum 3 days of playtime,
  • You must have a microphone (I am not that strict about that),
  • You need to speak English language fluently (Not that strict about that either, but you need to be able to communicate with our members),
  • You must have an account on Discord,
  • You should not use any hacked clients (in case you get caught, you might not be able to rejoin the team),
  • You must be at least 13 years old.

In case you meet these requirements, feel free to apply for a position using the following format:

  • Username:
  • What position would the best fit your skills? Choose one or more positions from Midfielder, Defender, Attacker
  • Discord username:
  • Why do you think you should be a part of this team?
  • Past experiences: 
  • Timezone:
  • Do you have the ability to record the matches? (Not a requirement)
  • Would you like to add anything?
Good luck to everyone willing to apply!

Kind regards,
EncryptedShoesHD!
